yearCards.text: Citizens yield no influence this year.

yearCards.text: Luxuries give no happiness this year.
yearCards.flavor: The dye and the incense sit in the holds.

yearCards.name: Festival

playerEvents.name: Good Stores
playerEvents.flavor: The storehouse jars are full to the shoulder.

playerEvents.name: Timber
playerEvents.flavor: A storm brought down the old oaks on the ridge.

playerEvents.name: Shipment

playerEvents.name: Profit
playerEvents.flavor: A cargo of oil sold high in the harbour market.

playerEvents.name: Patronage

riotTable.name: Riot
riotTable.flavor: The agora fills with angry voices. Declare your concessions before the dice decide.

devCards.name: Foraging
devCards.text: Gain 1 food for each of your settlements.
devCards.flavor: Every hamlet sends its children out to the hedgerows.

devCards.name: Woodcutters
devCards.text: Gain 1 wood for each of your settlements.
devCards.flavor: Axes ring in every village wood.

devCards.name: Quarry Gang
devCards.text: Gain 1 stone for each of your settlements.
devCards.flavor: A gang with wedges and rope works each hillside.

devCards.name: Bountiful Harvest
devCards.text: Gain 1 food for each pop in your realm.
devCards.flavor: Every hand in the realm brings in a sheaf.

devCards.name: Civic Feast
devCards.text: Gain 1 influence for each pop in your realm.
devCards.flavor: An ox roasts in the agora, and every guest remembers the host.

devCards.name: Tunny Run
devCards.flavor: The tunny shoals come close inshore, and the nets come up full.

devCards.name: Timber Raft
devCards.flavor: Logs lashed together ride the river down on the flood.

devCards.name: Marble Block
devCards.flavor: A flawless block from the new face of the quarry.

devCards.name: Caravan
devCards.text: Gain 1 wood, stone or food for each of your settlements: one kind, chosen when you play it.
devCards.flavor: Mules loaded at every gate, bound wherever you send them.

devCards.name: Settlers
devCards.text: Gain a freeman in one of your settlements with room.
devCards.flavor: Families and seed-grain, seeking a kinder shore.

devCards.name: Captives
devCards.text: Gain a slave in one of your settlements with room.
devCards.flavor: Prisoners from a border raid, roped at the neck.

devCards.name: Master Builder
devCards.text: Your next building or colony upgrade this turn costs 2 less wood or stone: one kind, chosen when you play it.
devCards.flavor: He knows where every block will sit before the first is cut.

devCards.name: Festival Day
devCards.text: Clear one of your Unrest tokens.
devCards.flavor: Garlands, wine, and a day off work.

devCards.name: Raiders
devCards.text: Take up to 3 wood, stone, food or gold from a rival you pick: one kind, and no more than they hold.
devCards.flavor: They come at night and are gone before the alarm.

devCards.name: Agitators
devCards.text: A rival you pick places an Unrest token.
devCards.flavor: Paid voices in a rival's market.

devCards.name: Informer
devCards.text: A rival you pick discards a held card, drawn at random.
devCards.flavor: A servant who listens at doors, and sells what he hears.

resolutions.name: Land Reform
resolutions.text: Slaves grow food on any terrain, but Estates may not be built.

resolutions.name: Sacred Fields
resolutions.text: Temples also grow 2 food, but cost 6 stone.

resolutions.name: Manumission
resolutions.text: Promoting a slave is free, but slaves count twice for unrest.

resolutions.name: Tenant Rights
resolutions.text: Growing a slave costs 2 gold; growing a freeman costs 3 gold.

resolutions.name: Grain Levy
resolutions.text: Freemen eat no food, but Marketplaces do nothing.

resolutions.name: Festival Calendar
resolutions.text: Civic calm costs 2 food or 2 influence.

resolutions.name: Public Works
resolutions.text: Estates and Granaries cost 3 wood; Marketplaces cost 2 wood and 2 gold. Colonies hold 3 pops.

resolutions.name: Guild Charter
resolutions.text: Your capital may grow twice as often each turn, but colonies may not grow.

resolutions.name: Rural Messengers
resolutions.text: Citizens in colonies make 2 influence; freemen in colonies make 0 gold.

resolutions.name: Civic Pride
resolutions.text: Your realm gains 1 happiness, but each city pays 1 gold a year.

resolutions.name: Master Builders
resolutions.text: Cities gain one building slot, but you may place one fewer colony piece.

resolutions.name: Homestead Act
resolutions.text: Colonies may hold one building, but cities lose one slot.

resolutions.name: Colonial Charter
resolutions.text: Founding a colony costs 1 food and a pop; upgrading one costs 6 stone.

resolutions.name: Frontier Spirit
resolutions.text: Founding a colony grants a free slave, but colonies hold 3 pops.

resolutions.name: Harbour Dues
resolutions.text: Ports cost 2 stone; Marketplaces cost 3 wood and 4 gold.

resolutions.name: Rural Bloc
resolutions.text: Each colony casts one vote, but each city casts one fewer.

resolutions.name: Grain Riot
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. They lose 3 food.

resolutions.name: The Streets Burn
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. They place an Unrest token.

resolutions.name: General Strike
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. They collect no income next turn.

resolutions.name: The Mob Rises
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. They lose a pop from their largest settlement.

resolutions.name: The Stele Is Broken
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. Their newest authored Law is repealed if its minimum tenure has ended.

resolutions.name: Isonomia
resolutions.text: Choose a rival. They have one base vote at the next Assembly.
